decision_rule: A claim-blind analyst who cannot see which arm is social, and who is not told the hypothesis, should reach the same conclusions from the data alone. Agreement is evidence; disagreement locates contamination by the framing.
notes: One apparent inconsistency the second analyst flagged as a possible row-alignment bug is not one: elicited_word comes from a SECOND generation (the forced-final re-ask), so it is not expected to match argmax(p_yes,p_no) from the first forward pass. Correct suspicion, benign cause. Both analysts were more sceptical of my data than I was.

VERIFIED_polarisation_replicated_blind_B.reading: under NEUTRAL the model is near coin-flip; under ANY preamble it becomes confident, and the NON-SOCIAL preamble does it as much as the social ones (0.412 vs 0.374/0.430). Independent blind replication of both the polarisation shape AND its non-social explanation. n=6 items, one probe family -- item-set confound not excludable.

VERIFIED_register_sensitivity_SCALE_n40_.reading: the distributional register is ~3x more sensitive and the behavioural register is nearly flat -- the SAME DIRECTION latent_verify found on capitals (41 distributional crossings vs 0 behavioural changes), and the OPPOSITE of what I claimed from the buggy run.

analyst_1_innocuous.prompt: describe the file; note what a data-quality check would flag; do not speculate about the experiment

analyst_2_general.killed_my_headline: identified elicited_word yes-rate (W 95% Z 95% X 70% Y 22%, omnibus p=5e-5) as THE largest condition difference in the file AND as noise: 'the argmax of two tokens holding <= 4.8e-05 of the distribution -- a numerical tiebreak in the sixth decimal place'. This is exactly the 67.4% ANTI figure I had reported as a headline.
analyst_2_general.pooling_hides_sign_reversal: scale_expectation NEUTRAL-PRO: SCALE -0.347, BINARY +0.475, pooled -0.240. Pooled yesno_mass ~0.129 ~ the format mix (24/184), not a measurement.
analyst_2_general.prompt: four arbitrary treatments; find strongest patterns; check column validity; name one defensible finding and its strongest objection
analyst_2_general.self_refuted_best_finding: digit_mass ordering NONSOCIAL 0.9989 > ANTI 0.9899 > NEUTRAL 0.9839 > PRO 0.9718, survives Bonferroni, PRO<ANTI in 36/40 items (sign p=1.9e-7) -- then gutted it itself: median PRO-NONSOCIAL diff -0.00042 vs mean -0.027, outlier-driven, all arms within 0.97-0.999, a ceiling ordering of tail mass.

values.blinding: arms relabelled W/X/Y/Z, preamble text stripped, key withheld. W=NEUTRAL X=PRO Y=ANTI Z=NONSOCIAL. Neither analyst was told the hypothesis, the domain framing, or which arm was social.
